name: manual_478769
claim: A shell fix that must guarantee a specific environment value (e.g. forcing UTF-8 locale before parsing tracked text) needs an unconditional assignment, not a ${VAR:-default} fallback — the fallback only fires when the var is unset/empty, so a caller's pre-existing conflicting value silently survives and the fix's stated guarantee is never met.

decisions.notes: Found on PT PR #241: export LC_ALL="${LC_ALL:-C.UTF-8}" in ecc-submodule-sync.sh was copy-pasted verbatim from the fix plan itself, so both the plan and the implementation shared the same gap. CodeRabbit's automated re-review of the fix commit (8f04c4b1) caught it independently; manual review confirmed the same reasoning before seeing that comment.
